Team dossier Operation Where Are They

The Crimson Crew

Allegedly exists. Case file: pending.

Team color
Red
Threat level
Unknown. Clueso has not met them.
Catnip & Hairball
Unrated

Known for

  • Not appearing in a single case file.
  • A name that sounds like a very serious rap group.
  • Being the quietest team in the game, which is suspicious.
  • Existing. Allegedly.

The file

The Crimson Crew is the only team that has not yet appeared in a PNN case file as a subject, a victim, a suspect, or a punchline. Clueso finds this slightly insulting. He has been circling the team's name on the list with a red pen.

Possible explanations: they are planning something enormous. They are planning something small. They are planning nothing. They are lost. Clueso favors 'planning something enormous' because 'lost' is the Black Webb Bandits' department.

PNN has no complaints about the Crimson Crew. This is the complaint. A team with a name like that should be setting something off, hoisting something up, or at least hanging something from a flagpole. PNN has checked the flagpoles. Nobody is hoisting.

In fairness, a quiet team is a dangerous team, which Clueso says about every team, including this one. The Crew may be waiting for the right moment. The right moment is now. The party is October 24.

Strengths

  • A sharp, serious name. Nobody is laughing at the name.
  • Mystery. Total, unearned mystery.
  • A clean record, which has made PNN nervous.

Weaknesses

  • Appearing in a case file.
  • Making a noise.
  • Any evidence that they exist.

Clueso's advice

Do something, anything, loudly and within the rules. Clueso has an empty folder labeled 'Crimson' and he is tired of looking at it.

— Inspector Clueso, PNN
